relationships.subject: Duloxetine
relationships.evidence_quote: Molecular docking showed that Duloxetine binds with pSTAT3 with binding energy -5.83 kcal/mol.

relationships.subject: Duloxetine
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot showed that Duloxetine significantly reduced IL-6-induced STAT3 and pSTAT3 expression in C2C12 cells in a dose-dependent manner

relationships.subject: Ruxolitinib
relationships.evidence_quote: Similarly, Ruxolitinib treatment at both 12.8 µM and 6.4 µM caused a profound reduction in pSTAT3 and STAT3 expression (p < 0.0001).

key_findings: Duloxetine dose-dependently reduced IL-6-induced STAT3/pSTAT3 in C2C12 cells and docked to pSTAT3, though less potently than ruxolitinib.
STAT3 transcript abundance was unchanged by either drug, while novel STAT3 isoforms and splicing were modulated.
